cue.heading: Rule 61 — Harmless error
cue.text: Unless justice requires otherwise, <mark>no error</mark> in admitting or excluding evidence—or any other error by the court or a party—is ground for granting a new trial, for setting aside a verdict, or for vacating, modifying, or otherwise disturbing a judgment or order.
cue.source: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, Rule 61, first sentence
